lines.text: Three police mistakes that keep you wanted in GTA 6.
One. Thinking red stars mean you're clear. Cops can still spot your face, clothes and car.
Two. Keeping the getaway car. Once it's spotted, switch rides.
Three. Going back to the scene. That area can stay hot after you escape.
Which one got you? Follow for more GTA 6 tips.
